snippet.title: SS Aurelia - AI Detective Game | Official Trailer (1936)
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam → https://store.steampowered.com/app/4615680

Atlantic Ocean. September 1936. A shipping magnate found dead. Five suspects. One killer. Every conversation is unique — powered by live AI.

🔍 Interrogate 5 suspects with real questions
🎭 Watch them crack under pressure
📋 Collect 18 pieces of evidence
🤖 Real-time AI — no two games identical
🌐 English / Chinese / Japanese

Coming April 30, 2026.
